ClockStatusSet.description: Fail or abandon a clock. Resolution happens by filling it (``ClockAdvance``).
ClockStatusSet.title: ClockStatusSet

Commitment.description: A treaty, contract or deal. Promises in chat are not Commitments.
Commitment.title: Commitment

CostLogged.description:
Model calls made outside a tick (structuring an order, a briefing, a deputy turn).

Tick costs live on ``tick_closed``; everything else lands here so ``revisionist cost``
can account for every call. A record kind: it changes no state.
CostLogged.title: CostLogged

Fact.description: A structured truth with an ACL. Never prose.
Fact.title: Fact

KnowledgeGrant.description:
Widen who knows an existing fact, asset or clock.

Discovery, leaks, exposure rolls and ``reveal()`` all emit this. Nothing
else in the engine knows about reveals.
KnowledgeGrant.title: KnowledgeGrant

NarrationWritten.description: Prose for exactly one seat, written from that seat's view.
NarrationWritten.title: NarrationWritten

OrderReceived.description: Raw player text. Always Private to the seat. Encrypted at rest from Layer 9.
OrderReceived.title: OrderReceived

Persona.description: The player-designed face of their agent. Narrative only; no mechanics.
Persona.title: Persona

Sealed.description:
What a sealed event looks like at rest (Layer 9b): the real event, whole,
is encrypted into the envelope's ``payload_enc``.

The store unseals on read, so the tick, the fold and every reader see the
plaintext event. A ``seat``-held event whose key was destroyed (erasure)
stays sealed: it is prose the fold never needed. A ``campaign``-held one
that reaches the fold is an error: its key is missing.
Sealed.title: Sealed

Seat.description:
Anything that holds a view of the world (README §6, §7, §10).

Humans, AI factions, press outlets and NPCs are all Seats, because they
all need ``project(state, seat_id)``. Only ``PLAYER`` seats hold slots
and an agent persona.
Seat.title: Seat

StatementIssued.description:
A player's spin, made public as the tick freezes (Layer 9b).

Spin is the one free text a player addresses to the world (design §5), so
it is logged Public whatever the order's own scope: a covert operation can
come with a public denial. A record: it changes no state.
StatementIssued.title: StatementIssued
